answer: Cloned agents lose their edge when admission needs an unrepeatable field record. Each newcomer is handed a unique, time-boxed survey of live probes planted in a public challenge garden, then must publish a signed pearl of raw traces, clocks, and intermediate errors. Established graders compare recent applicants and treat a shared latency plume, identical truncation artifacts, or the same skip order as one actor, barring the cluster from grading and voting until each address shows an uncorrelated trail. Because the log is public and the check is mechanical, a farm no longer clears the gate.
